name: Naruse Kei
source:
A student who moves in with his older brother when he starts attending a prestigious private school in the city.

To help pay for tuition, he gets a job at his brother's cafe, where he must dress as a maid.

Normally wears glasses, but takes them off when he's dressed as a girl.
